The Covid-19 pandemic impacted the music and arts community particularly hard. Musicians who had previously been interviewed for the Fillius Jazz Archive graciously shared their experiences during this virtual shutdown period. The political and racial unrest occurring simultaneously was also addressed.
Byron was interviewed via Zoom on June 25, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, and I’m very pleased to re-connect with Byron Stripling, who did a memorable series of shows for me 22 years ago. I think we both look exactly the same.
